content: Adaf n Yasuɛ ɣar Urcalim am ujeǧid
Řami dd-qarrben ɣar Urcalim, iwḍen ɣar Bayt-Faji, ɣar uɣezdis n wedrar n Zzitun, issekk Yasuɛ tnayen n imeḥḍaren nnes, inna asen:
“Ruḥem ɣar dcar nni qibač nwem. Deɣya ad tafem ict n teɣyuč teqqen d ijj n wesnus akides. Fesyem asen, tawyem ten-dd ɣari.
Mařa inna awem ḥed ca, arrem xas ammu: ‘Aqa Siditneɣ iḥdaj i-ten. Netta ad ten dd-yarr deɣya.’”
Man aya qaɛ imsar, ḥima ad ittwakemmeř marra min ittwannan zeg unabi am inna:
“Inim i yeǧis n Ṣihyun: ‘Xzar, Ajeǧid nnem ad ɣarem dd-yas s uwaḍeɛ, yenya x weɣyuř d wesnus, aqa d mmis n teɣyuč.”
Ruḥen imeḥḍaren uca ggin am mammec ten yumur Yasuɛ.
Iwyen-dd aɣyuř d wesnus, sarsen arruḍ nsen x wesnus uca inya xas Yasuɛ.
Aṭṭas zi řɣaci ssun arruḍ nsen deg webrid u inneɣni qessen řefruɛ zi tcejjura, nḍaren ten deg webrid.
Uca abarru n řɣaci nni d as izwaren d yinni i-t-i-dd iḍfaren, tuɣa sɣuyyun, nnan:
“Uṣanna i Mmis n Dawud! Lbaraka i Wenni dd-yusin s Yisem n SIDI. Uṣanna, di řuɛřa x řuɛřa n ijenwan.”
Řami yudef ɣar Urcalim, thaj tendint qaɛ, iwdan nnan: “Min iɛna Wa?”
Řɣaci inna: “D Wa d Anabi Yasuɛ zi Nnaṣira di Ljalil.”
Yasuɛ di Zzawect Tameqqrant
Yudef Yasuɛ ɣar Zzawect Tameqqrant n AREBBI, issuffeɣ marra inni izznuzan d yinni issaɣen di Zzawect Tameqqrant uca iqřeb ṭṭwabeř n iṣarrafen n tenɛacin d řekrasi n yinni izznuzan idbiren.
Inna asen: “Aqa tura: ‘Taddart inu ad tᵉttwasemma ‘Taddart n tẓaǧit’, maca kenniw tarrim tt d ifri n iceffaren.’”
Iwyen-dd ɣares di Zzawect Tameqqrant idarɣařen d ineɛḍaben uca issgenfa ten.
Umi ẓrin imeqqranen n ikehhanen d imseřmaden n idlisen lmuɛjizat i yegga u aqa iḥenjiren ttřaɣan di Zzawect Tameqqrant, qqaren: “Uṣanna i Mmis n Dawud!”, xeyyqen aṭṭas,
nnan as: “Ma tesřid min qqaren yina?” Inna asen Yasuɛ: “Wah, ma war teɣrim ɛemmarṣ: ‘Zeg iqemmumen n iḥenjiren d iseyman tesswejded Cek ttesbiḥ’?”
Řexdenni ismeḥ daysen, iffeɣ barra i tendint ɣar Bayt-Ɛanya, insa din.
Artu yuẓɣen
Ɣar ṣṣbeḥ zic řami dd-idweř ɣar tendint, tuɣa dayes řaẓ.
Iẓra ijj n wartu x webrid, iruḥ ɣares, war dayes yufi mɣir tifray waha. Xenni inna i wartu: “War zzayek tteffeɣ řɣiǧet ɛemmarṣ.” Řexdenni yuẓeɣ wartu deɣya.
Umi ẓrin imeḥḍaren man aya, tbehten, nnan: “Mammec igga wartu yuẓeɣ deɣya?”

Yasuɛ yarra-dd, inna asen: “S tidett Necc ad awem iniɣ: Mařa daywem l’iman u war tcekkim ca, aqa war tᵉtteggem min imsaren i wartu waha, maca ɛawed mařa tennam i wedrar-a: ‘Meksi, wḍa di řebḥar!’, ad yiři.
D qaɛ min ɣa tᵉttarem di tẓaǧit s l’iman, ad t tᵉṭṭfem.”
Aseqsi x ttesriḥ n Yasuɛ
Řami yudef ɣar Zzawect Tameqqrant, usin-dd ɣares imeqqranen n ikehhanen d imɣaren n řgens am tuɣa isseřmad, nnan: “S man ṣṣulṭa i teggid timesřayin-a? Wi d ac iwcin ṣṣulṭa-ya?”
Yasuɛ yarra-dd, inna asen “Uřa d Necc ad kenniw sseqsiɣ ijj n useqsi u mařa tarrim-dd xafi uřa d Necc ad awem iniɣ s man ṣṣulṭa i tteggeɣ timesřayin-a.
Aseɣḍaṣ n Yuḥanna, manis netta? Zeg ujenna niɣ zeg iwdan?” Mcawaren nitni jar asen, nnan: “Mařa nenna: ‘Zeg ujenna!’, ad aneɣ ini: ‘Mayemmi war zzayes tuminem?’,
u mařa nenna: ‘Zeg iwdan!’, xenni dayneɣ tiggʷudi zi řɣaci, minzi marra ḥessben Yuḥanna d anabi.”
Arrin-dd, nnan: “War nessin.” Inna asen Netta: “Xenni uřa d Necc war d awem qqareɣ s man ṣṣulṭa i tteggeɣ man aya.”
Amedya n tnayen n wawmaten
“Min d awem ittɣiř kenniw? Ijj n weryaz tuɣa ɣares tnayen n iḥenjiren. Iřaɣa x umezwaru, inna: ‘A mmi, uyur, ass-a ad txedmed deg umarjeɛ n uḍiř!’
Netta yarra-dd, inna: ‘Necc war xseɣ ca!’, maca awarni man aya indem uca iruḥ din.
Uca yusa-dd netta ɣar wenni wiss tnayen, inna as amenni beɛda. Wanita yarra-dd xas: ‘Wah, a sidi!’, maca war iruḥ ca!

Man wen zzaysen i iggin řxaḍar i babas?” Nitni arrin-dd xas: “Wenni d amezwaru.” Yasuɛ inna asen: “S tidett, Necc ad awem iniɣ, aqa ayt n ḍḍariba d temɣarin n farq-ccɣeř ad awem izwaren ɣar Tgeldit n AREBBI.

Minzi Yuḥanna yusa-dd ɣarwem deg webrid n tsegda, kenniw war zzayes tuminem, maca ayt n ḍḍariba d temɣarin n farq-ccɣeř aqa nitni umnen zzayes. Řami teẓrim man aya, war tᵉtubem ca ɣar uneggaru, maḥend ad zzayes tamnem.”
Amedya n ixemmasen deg umarjuɛ n tzayart

“Sřem ɛawed i yijj n umedya nneɣni. Tuɣa din ijj n weryaz, bab n taddart, igga ijj n umarjeɛ n uḍiř, iẓẓu dayes tizayarin. Netta iquwwar as-dd s yijj n wefray, iɣza dayes tasirt n uḍiř uca ibna dayes ict n ṣṣumɛet. Xenni yarhen amarjeɛ nni n uḍiř i ca n ixemmasen uca isafar.
Umi dd-tiweḍ řweqt n ṣṣabet n řɣiǧet, issekk imsexxaren nnes ɣar ixemmasen nni ḥima ad dd-awyen řɣiǧet nnes.
Ixemmasen ṭṭfen imsexxaren nnes, wtin ijjen, nɣin nneɣni uca arejmen ɛawed ijjen nneɣni.
Ɛawed issekk imsexxaren nneɣni, ktar zeg umezwaru, uca ggin daysen ɛawed amenni.
Ɣar uneggar issekk asen-dd mmis, inna: ‘Nican ad weqqaren mmi’.
Maca řami ẓrin ixemmasen mmis, nnan jar asen: ‘Aqa d awrit, zidem, ad t neneɣ, ad as nekkes řwart i neccin.’
Ṭṭfen t, nḍaren t barra i umarjeɛ n uḍiř uca nɣin t.
Mařa yusa-dd bab n umarjeɛ nni, min ɣa yegg deg ixemmasen nni?”
Nnan as: “Ad yareddeǧ iɛeffanen nni qaɛ, uca ad iwc amarjeɛ n uḍiř i ixemmasen nneɣni inni d as i ɣa iwcen řɣiǧet di řweqt nnes.”
Yasuɛ inna asen: “Ma war teɣrim ɛemmarṣ deg idlisen:
‘Aẓru i iɛiffen ibennayen, aqa idweř d aẓru Azeǧif n teɣmart. Wa yusa-dd zi SIDI u man aya d řeɛjeb di tiṭṭawin nneɣ.’
S uyenni ad awem iniɣ, belli Tageldit n AREBBI ad awem tᵉttwakkes uca ad temmewc i yijj n řgens i ɣa iwcen řɣiǧet nnes.
Wi ɣa iwḍan x weẓru-ya, ad ittwařbez, u wi xef i ɣa iwḍa, ad t iřbez.”
Řami sřin imeqqranen n ikehhanen d Ifarisiyyen imedya nnes, fehmen belli issawař xasen.
Arezzun ad t ṭṭfen, maca ggʷeden zi řɣaci, minzi řɣaci tuɣa iḥesseb i-t d ijj n unabi.
